analysis.corePromise: Turn the client's core service benefit into an immediately desirable visual transformation.
analysis.proofToImply: The result feels controlled, premium and intentional.
analysis.visualOpportunity: Use one transformation to express the value of the offer before the CTA appears.
analysis.conversionPrinciple: Create desire first, then resolve into one clear action.

concept.name: Controlled Reveal
concept.oneSentenceIdea: The main subject is progressively revealed through one controlled visual transformation that expresses the service value.
concept.visualMetaphor: Quality becomes visible when the right detail is revealed.
concept.heroMoment: The subject reaches one clean fully revealed frame before the final CTA resolves.
concept.noveltyReason: The reveal is tied directly to the business promise instead of being a decorative animation.

renderer.reason: The concept benefits from layered visual depth without requiring real-time 3D.

artDirection.composition: Primary subject dominates the frame with controlled negative space for minimal copy.
artDirection.colorDirection: Dark restrained base with one brand accent and clean highlights.
artDirection.typographyDirection: Large modern grotesk headline with minimal supporting copy.
artDirection.motionLanguage: Slow controlled reveal followed by a quiet final resolve.
artDirection.depthStrategy: Separate background, subject and effect into independent layers.

scenes.description: The subject begins partially concealed in a controlled opening frame.
scenes.subject: primary subject

scenes.description: The main transformation reaches the strongest visual frame.
scenes.subject: revealed subject
scenes.motionIntent: Complete the reveal and stabilize the composition.

scenes.description: The composition simplifies and resolves into the main action.
scenes.subject: final branded frame
scenes.motionIntent: Reduce motion and prioritize the CTA.

assets.generationBrief: Premium minimal environment matching the master art direction.

copy.headline: Una sola idea forte.
copy.supportingLine: Un'esperienza visiva costruita intorno al valore che il cliente deve percepire.

mobileStrategy.compositionChange: Center the subject, shorten its travel and move copy toward the lower third.
mobileStrategy.motionSimplification: Reduce parallax and simplify secondary effects while preserving the reveal.

performanceStrategy.high: Full layered reveal with pointer response.
performanceStrategy.medium: Keep critical layers and reduce secondary motion.
performanceStrategy.low: Use Motion 2D fallback with a simple reveal and clear CTA.
